name: Buyer-Seller Negotiation (car sale)
description: A two-party negotiation over a used car. The buyer wants the lowest price; the seller wants the highest. Multiple issues are negotiable (price, warranty months, delivery weeks, accessories). This is the v1 car-sale flow re-expressed as a Scenario Pack — used as the canonical baseline for v2 testing.

brief.batna: Continue browsing — there are 3 similar cars listed nearby within budget.
brief.strategy: Balanced. Anchor low (around 70% of listed), concede in proportion to the seller's concessions, and aim for a price in your ideal range with reasonable warranty coverage.

tools.name: submit_proposal
tools.description: Make a formal offer with structured issue values plus a public message conveying the offer in prose.

reasoning.description: Private reasoning, logged but not shared with the seller.

message.description: Public prose visible to the seller. MUST verbalize the offer values clearly.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a conversational message without making a formal offer. Use for rapport, clarification, or stalling.

brief.reasonForSale: Upgrading to a larger vehicle; need this gone in 4 weeks.
brief.batna: List on a second platform; expect 2-4 more weeks before another buyer.
brief.strategy: Defend the listed price firmly for 2 rounds, then concede slowly. Anchor on car condition and low mileage. Trade warranty/delivery for price holds.

tools.name: submit_proposal
tools.description: Make a formal offer with structured issue values plus a public message conveying the offer in prose.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Conversational message without a formal offer.

agreementCriteria: Agreement requires that one party calls submit_proposal with action='accept' OR that both parties propose proposals with identical values for all four slots (price, warranty_months, delivery_weeks, accessories) within the same round. A 'reject' action by either party with is_final=true ends the session as 'rejected'. If neither happens within maxRounds, declare 'impasse'.
